relations: As the handheld wand sweeps across the rug, foam and loosened soil are displaced toward the edges.
The blue blower directs airflow over the wet surface, gradually reducing the visible foam layer.
Repeated passes thin the soapy water, revealing the rug's original color beneath the dirty patch.
Liquid residue pools around the wand tip and spreads outward as pressure is applied.
